_comment: DRAFT — not yet validated against Meta's live Flow Builder schema checker.
One generic Flow, reused for all 5 document groups (cheque, memo, notice,
id, support): the group-specific label/description/min/max are supplied
at send time via the Twilio whatsapp/flows Content Template's
flow_action_payload, bound here through this screen's `data` schema.
Uses DocumentPicker (not PhotoPicker) because this app already accepts
JPEG/PNG/PDF for every group (see src/domain/filing-document.ts's
isAllowedContentType) — PhotoPicker is camera/gallery images only, no PDF.
OPEN QUESTIONS to resolve by pasting this into Meta's Flow Builder
(it validates live) and running Phase 0's spike:
1. Does binding min-uploaded-documents/max-uploaded-documents to
${data.*} actually work, or must those be literal integers per
screen (in which case this would need 5 near-identical screens/Flows
instead of 1 generic one)?
2. Does the `complete` action below actually deliver the uploaded
files (as a fetchable URL, or a Meta media ID) through the normal
Twilio-relayed webhook, or does Meta require `data_exchange` (a live
encrypted endpoint) for any screen containing a DocumentPicker?
3. What is the minimum Flow JSON `version` this account's Flow Builder
accepts?

group_description.__example__: Photograph the cheque that bounced. Front and back, in good light.
